in_hebrew.name: Fahland
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fahland הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German word "fah" meaning "journey" and "land" meaning "land". This name was given to a protector of lands or a traveler who established a new territory.

in_greek.name: Fahland
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Land protector
in_greek.long_meaning: Fahland είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old German word "fah" meaning "journey" and "land" meaning "land". This name was given to a protector of lands or a traveler who established a new territory.

in_latin.name: Fahland
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Land protector
